**Date of Agreement:** May 17, 2023

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Helios Technologies, Inc., a Florida corporation, is the borrower under this incremental term loan facility.

**Transaction Description:** This transaction represents an Incremental Facility Amendment to Helios Technologies' existing Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated October 28, 2020. The structure involves a new Term Loan A-2 facility of $150 million provided by a syndicate of eight lenders, with PNC Bank, National Association serving as Administrative Agent. PNC Capital Markets LLC acts as Joint Lead Arranger and Sole Bookrunner, with Truist Securities, Inc. as Joint Lead Arranger.

**Purpose of Financing:** The Term Loan A-2 proceeds will be used for working capital, Permitted Acquisitions, refinancing outstanding Revolving Credit Loans and other Indebtedness, and other lawful corporate purposes.

**Company Background:** Based on the credit agreement, Helios Technologies operates through multiple subsidiaries including Enovation Controls, LLC; Sun Hydraulics, LLC; Faster, Inc.; SPA & Bath Holdings, Inc.; Balboa Water Group, LLC; and several other operating entities across various states. All subsidiaries serve as guarantors under the facility.

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths/Credit Positives:
• **Diversified Lender Syndicate:** Eight-bank syndicate led by established institutions (PNC, Truist, Citibank, Regions, Wells Fargo, BMO Harris, Synovus, M&T) provides funding stability
• **Pari Passu Structure:** Term Loan A-2 ranks equally with other loans under the credit agreement in right of payment and security
• **Full Guarantee Coverage:** Multiple subsidiary guarantors provide additional credit support
• **Established Credit Facility:** Amendment to existing 2020 credit agreement indicates ongoing banking relationship and lender familiarity
• **Bullet Maturity:** No amortization requirements prior to maturity reduces near-term cash flow pressure

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Limited Financial Information:** No specific financial metrics, covenants, or company performance data provided in the amendment
• **Acquisition Funding Risk:** Permitted use for acquisitions introduces execution and integration risks
• **Refinancing Component:** Partial use to refinance existing debt suggests potential liquidity management needs
• **Economic Sensitivity:** Multiple operating subsidiaries across different sectors may indicate exposure to various economic cycles

**Mitigating Factors:**
• Financial covenant compliance required and certified as of effective date
• Comprehensive conditions precedent including solvency certifications
• Administrative Agent oversight and monitoring through PNC Bank
